author: jih2nn
content:
We had a discussion on merging #5509 in the last ACDT's CL breakout. The conclusion was to merge this after we ship Gloas.

I looked into this more to see when it could cause a split and how severe it is. It's reasonable to say that this is not likely to happen in mainnet because there are many conditions to be met, but I think we should avoid that possibility. It had happened before that participation dropped below two third due to client bugs. We usually can rely on client diversity to overcome such situation, but this is where client diversity could cause a trouble instead. For more context, please refer to this [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5509#issuecomment-5779969376).

author: jih2nn
content: I've talked with clients and this is what I learned: Prysm and Lodestar are already align with #5509, Lighthouse can implement this before Sepolia, Nimbus could do it by Gloas mainnet fork and Teku is fine with merging the PR.

author: jtraglia
content: If clients are fine with merging it sooner, it has my support.

author: m.kalinin
content: I am in favor of merging PR into the spec. Clients can make the corresponding fix as soon as it is possible for them. This is a FC change and can be rolled out at any point in time, even soon after the fork but it would be great if it is done before cause then we can be sure that the majority will be aligned around that corner case behavior.

content: +1 from lodestar, we already follow #5509 and just put up a PR today to remove our workaround in the compliance spec runner [here](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/10156) and ran tests generated from 5509 which we now pass without issues, that was the last remaining problem for us to pass all tests
